subject: statistics: fix the behavior of DROP STATS after #58596 (#59031)
summary: Reviewed 32d11a87 vs first parent (3a378c8e) in executor/statistics. DROP STATS now performs a soft reset of `mysql.stats_histograms` (keeps per-column/index rows but zeroes meta + sets `stats_ver=0`) instead of hard-deleting, and stats loading normalizes table `StatsVer` to `Version0` when all loaded col/idx stats are `Version0`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/consistency/concurrency/compatibility within the touched scope; later upstream history was checked for follow-up fixes.
